title: Dolphin Watch, Snorkel, Open Bar & 1 Day Hop-On Hop-Off
includes: 1 day Hop On Hop Off Fun on the Conch Train
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This is the best 1 day combo where you will enjoy the water and land in Key West. Get to Hop On Hop off the conch train, one of Florida's most popular attractions, going to Truval Village: Steps away from the Ernest Hemingway Home and Museum, the Key West Lighthouse, the Southernmost Point and Key West Butterfly and Nature Conservatory. Start the day with a Catamaran adventure going Delphine watching and then snorkeling in 1 of the worlds largest reefs. We may even see sea turtle and other exotic fish. 
On the return enjoy and open bar that includes well mixed drinks, draft beer, margaritas, rum runners and a great selection of wine & champagne.
As an added benefit join us at the Sails and rails museum to learn our history.
